value.rationale: Rule 22 is a heavily studied exactly-one nonlinear cellular automaton with known oscillations on small rings. Classifying all ring sizes, counting every labelled least-six temporal orbit, and separating an invariant four-orbit eight-resonance from a growing ten-resonance answers a natural missing periodic-spectrum question. The exact determinant factorization and arithmetic support law are substantive structural data, not a finite table extension or arbitrary parameter slice. It contrasts sharply with previously established temporal-four/five renewal spectra and can benchmark space-time transfer methods.
